title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Low cloud is down to about 3,300 ft; the night's dew is evaporating -- Kula Ag's dew point is up 3 °F since 04:00 and it is still 86% humid. Today's forecast: Thermals probably flat. Trades from the ENE should put the shear line at Pukalani. Kula Ag had about half sun over the last hour; cloud reaches all the way to the Summit. Upslope has not set in yet.
